- [ ] `python scripts/version.py check`

## Data and filesystem safety

- [ ] No filesystem-write behavior changed
- [ ] OR filesystem-write behavior was reviewed against library management modes
- [ ] Database migration included when required
- [ ] Scan failure/recovery behavior considered when relevant
- [ ] No credentials or private data added to the repository

## Changelog

- [ ] No user-visible changelog entry needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased`

Add screenshots or implementation notes when they help review the change.
